capabilities: Create daily, weekly and monthly notes from the calendar panel or commands
Manage per-day todos in a calendar panel with carry-over and date-prefix filing
Schedule todo reminders and optional email notifications
Generate weekly review summaries from diaries and todos
Enhance pasted code, images and Mermaid diagrams with toolbars and formatting
disambiguation: The name suggests only quick daily-note creation, but the plugin also bundles calendar todos, reminders, weekly reviews, image/Mermaid enhancements and an app background.
extras: Documentation is written primarily in Chinese with an English translation; email notifications depend on Web3Forms's free tier (~250 emails/month); installation via BRAT is described for the pre-listing period.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes require navigating menus, and there is no built-in calendar view for managing todos per day or scheduled reminders.

relations.evidence: so they sync across devices with vault sync tools (e.g. Remotely Save)
an email is sent to your custom mailbox (via Web3Forms, free tier ~250/month)

summary: Daily-notes and journal plugin with a calendar panel for per-day todos, reminders, weekly reviews, and paste, image and Mermaid enhancements.
